headline: Colombia Designates Venezuela Gas Pipeline Repair as Strategic Project
summary: Colombia named the repair of its Venezuela gas pipeline a strategic project, though the resumption of gas flows remains subject to a U.S. Treasury sanctions license.
why: Cross-border energy infrastructure projects are subject to geopolitical sanctions and international trade regulations that affect regional energy supply.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Restoring gas pipeline connectivity could diversify domestic energy supply sources.
